calendar.revision_policy: Actual exchange closure/calendar revision must be documented and confirmed; do not replace failed collection days with later successful days.

coverage_scope.denominator: All supported symbols in the complete dated full-market universe, including missing BaoStock rows, suspended, ST, IPO, unknown and failed calls. Never use only successfully returned bars.
coverage_scope.archive_scope: All A shares including excluded boards; report archived total, supported denominator and excluded board counts separately.

ordinary_regime_evidence.ordinary_predicate: Same-session hashed complete query_stock_basic row: exact code, type=1, status=1, outDate empty, valid code_name without ST/退/N/C markers; complete listing calendar proves more than five listed open sessions through target day; daily isST=0, tradestatus=1 and volume>0. Missing/mismatched evidence remains None.
ordinary_regime_evidence.delisting_scope: status=1 means listed, not proof of no delisting period. Non-delisting is an explicit inference from same-session BaoStock security name without 退 plus listed status and empty outDate; verify the name marker convention and a delisting positive during the approved probe. If that exclusion is not established, stop before enabling this regime derivation; do not silently treat status as ordinary=True.
ordinary_regime_evidence.special_policy: IPO first five sessions, ST, delisting/name markers, known special regimes, unsupported boards and anomalies remain None for limits. This is a versioned inference rule, not a provider-supplied ordinary-regime Boolean.

rules: Preserve v1/v2/v3 protocols, historical windows and all incomplete results. v4 has a new user-requested forward window, not modified acceptance thresholds.
BaoStock is the sole primary price source: exact code/date/batch, frequency d, adjustflag 3, original raw hash and real receipt time. Never assemble a price tuple across suppliers.

tradestatus=0 proves suspension even when volume/amount are empty. tradestatus=1 with finite strictly positive volume proves not suspended. Missing/zero/negative volume does not prove False; empty volume/amount are never replaced by zero. isST=0/1 alone supplies the dated ST fact.

Limits reuse v1 normal_price_band with BaoStock preclose and close: ordinary main board 10%, ChiNext 300/301 20%, Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP to cents. Derive ordinary regime from the explicitly defined same-session query_stock_basic + complete listing calendar + isST/tradestatus/positive volume inputs, not a blank exchange:trading-regime placeholder. Missing basic name/IPO/status/hash/date/calendar or excluded special states remain None.

Tushare daily is a separate unadjusted close/pre_close cross-check within 0.005. Unavailable is reported; conflicting primary prices prevent negative limit conclusions. No stk_limit, suspend_d, stock_basic or trade_cal requests on this route.

Eastmoney stock/get independently references limits and ST and negative suspension only: rc=0, exact f57, f59=2, same-session after-close f86 <= receipt. f58 name containing ST proves ST True; a valid nonempty name without ST or delisting markers references ST False. Missing/invalid names remain None. Strictly positive finite volume AND amount reference suspended=False; absent/zero values never prove suspended=True or False. Confirm f47/f48 field identity and units in the probe before enabling these references. Price/limit validation is independent of missing name/volume fields.

Same-date stock/get close/preclose must match BaoStock within 0.005 for comparisons. Snapshot name/time/price provenance is required for ST/suspension references too; limit bound failures need not block valid ST/trading reference candidates. Full-day suspension positive references must still be independently evidenced: no turnover is not sufficient.

Complete paginated namechange is optional ST supplementation only; keep actual receipt, active interval and announcement date. Permission/transport/incomplete-page failures are recorded, never block other fields or substitute current names for historical names. All original per-field coverage and positive sample thresholds still apply.
AKShare dated limit pools supply positive references only, never False from absence. BaoStock cannot independently validate its own suspension/ST, and Tushare price agreement is not risk agreement.

Coverage denominator matches v1 supported main-board/ChiNext prefixes only, selected from the whole dated full-market universe before results. Supported missing rows, ST, suspension, IPO and unknown remain in denominator. Archive excluded STAR/BJ too, report separately; no 20-percent STAR extension in this draft. Incomplete references prevent whole-tuple acceptance, not other field diagnostics.

Later receipts are research references only, never point-in-time prediction inputs. No tomorrow/current snapshot is backdated into a missed session. No trading, recommendation or production license follows automatically from archive completion or passing local tests.

collection.batch_probe: Test clist/get f2/f18 price/preclose, f14 name, f5/f6 volume/amount, f51/f52 limits and f124 timestamp in one raw page; verify actual meanings against stock/get. If supported symbols have valid dated prices and both actual supplied bounds, use batches for those symbols and stock/get only for missing/invalid batch records. Freeze confirmed endpoint mappings and strategy in a separately hashed operational capability record, not by guessing field numbers.
collection.raw_policy: Save original response bytes, SHA256 and real received_at for every response including invalid/error responses. Append-only per-run index and logs; exclusive directories; complete transport capture is distinct from valid reference coverage.
collection.enable_policy: No requests, timer installation or service start before explicit user approval and a frozen protocol whose byte hash matches a separate approval record. Stop automatically after the declared 20-date window; continuation requires confirmation.

activation: Draft only. User confirmation is required before freeze and collection enable. Separate evidence review and explicit confirmation are required before licensing, production integration, full verification/release, main merge and backed-up plugin-only reload.
